I’m Tiesha, a Computer Engineering student specializing in Cybersecurity, IoT, and Blockchain. I’m curious about technology, products, and how people use them.
I enjoy testing ideas, spotting what could work better, and bringing teams together. I’m still exploring where I’d like to go deeper—and learning as I go.
